 News Everything We Know About Manni L. Perez, ‘GTA 6’ Female Lead Lucia Caminos
 The voice actor behind the first playable female character in the “Grand Theft Auto” franchise has appeared on television shows from “Jessica Jones” to “Law & Order: SVU.” Nov. 19, 2026, 12:35 PM EST / Source : TODAY Kimmy Yam
 ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Delivers Unexpected Surprises and Cameos 03:03 Share Add TODAY to Google One of the buzziest aspects of the newly released “Grand Theft Auto VI” video game is its introduction of a major playable female character — the first in the “GTA” franchise, which has previously been criticized for its misogynistic content.
 While developer Rockstar Games has largely kept details about the long-awaited game under wraps, fans this week finally learned the identity of the voice actor behind new character Lucia Caminos. 
 Manni Perez, an actor, weightlifter and combat sports athlete, was revealed as the voice actor behind Lucia after she received a Game Awards nomination Nov. 17 for best performance. 
 Perez has so far not been a large part of the game’s promotion, however she publicly acknowledged her role in “GTA VI” on social media after the news of her nod. 
 Here’s what we know about Manni Perez. 
 Perez’s Character Lucia Is a Fugitive 
 Lucia, one of two characters that players can toggle between, is a a fighter who was recently released from prison and is hoping to thrive on the outside. 
 “More than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City — but instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands,” the game’s website says. 
 Together with her boyfriend, Jason, a military veteran who has a history of working with drug runners, Lucia embarks on a Bonnie-and-Clyde-type lifestyle to change her fortunes. However the couple gets caught up in the middle of a criminal conspiracy across the fictional state of Leonida after a robbery goes awry.
 Lucia and Jason are then “forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive,” the website says. 
 Perez Has Made Appearances on Screen, Including in “Law & Order: SVU”
 If Lucia’s voice sounds familiar to gamers, it’s likely because they’ve seen Perez before on screen. 
 The actor, who grew up in New York City and studied at NYU’s Tisch School of the Arts, according to IMBD, has appeared in several high-profile television series, including “Chicago P.D.,” “Blindspot” and Marvel’s “Jessica Jones.”
 In a 2020 episode of “SVU,” Perez played Esperanza Morales, a boxer who was arrested for murder after she attacked her boxing coach, who had been accused of raping a teen.
 Perez, who’s a practitioner of MMA, Muay Thai and Brazilian jiu-jitsu, has also worked as a professional belly dancer.
 The new game isn’t Perez’s first rodeo with the “Grand Theft Auto” franchise. She previously voiced a blackjack dealer for 2019’s “Grand Theft Auto Online.” 
 In an interview with the since-shuttered site Paz Magazine, Perez said that that her “biggest fear” was having to portray a “damsel in distress.”
 “I’d prefer to play a character that whatever she’s going through, no matter how hard society wants to keep her down, she picks herself up, puts her big girl panties on (preferably cotton [laughs]) and keeps it moving,” she told the outlet. 
 Perez Has Barely Said Anything About the Game
 Perez has said next to nothing about her involvement in the game. It wasn’t until the news of the Game Awards nomination that her identity was revealed. 
 Still, Perez hasn’t said much about the role aside from sharing a joint post Nov. 19 with the voice actor behind Jason, Dylan Rourke.
 “Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer. We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower,” the pair said in a joint Instagram post. “So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y’all in Leonida.”
